entries.en: daybreak; the dim hour before sunrise
entries.notes: L 栏作 Juventud q̃ abisona，与「黎」义不相合，疑与邻条错位；释义据 H「黎」及 M 栏末西语 al amanecer（黎明）。

entries.en: to judge; to decide as one pleases
to interrogate; to question in a trial
to judge right and wrong; to decide true from false
to try a case; to pass sentence
to judge rightly; to decide uprightly

entries.zh: 体察、体谅（以己心度人之心）
entries.en: to judge another's heart by one's own; to empathize
entries.notes: M 栏标 [残] 且两处 T99，H「體」与 L「以己心度人之心」仅大致相应，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 以己度人；以自己的心思衡量别人
entries.en: to judge another by one's own heart

entries.zh: 合你心意；依你的心意判断
entries.en: to your own liking; to judge as you please
entries.notes: L 作 juzgar desto（就此判断），与 H「過你心」的合意义略有出入。

entries.zh: 推己及人；以自身感受推想别人
entries.en: to put oneself in another's place; to extend one's own feelings to others
entries.notes: H 栏「已/己」形近存疑，按成语「推己及人」取「己」。

entries.zh: 将心比心；设身处地为他人着想
entries.en: to compare one's heart with another's; to put oneself in another's shoes

entries.zh: 力断；一口断定他人是非
entries.en: to judge another definitively; to assert flatly about someone
entries.notes: H 栏「叫/吐」存疑，M 栏 lià gŭioy sŷ 无法确证，仅据 L「juzgar determinadamente a otro」推其大意。
M 栏并列洗字白读 sé 与文读 sién（末字 sien/fien 存疑），字义与 labar（lavar，洗）相合。
H「稠」训浓稠，与 L labar（lavar，洗）义不相合，M 栏 tiū rōy, te 亦难串讲，疑字或条次有误。
M 栏 sèychoj / choj chioj / to guís 多不可辨，仅 H「灌」可定，与 labar（洗）义稍隔。
